findings.comment: Building elevation sheets with surveyed overhead conductor elevations and labeled clearance dimensions are required to verify the 7.5-foot horizontal sky-to-ground clearance requirement per UCM § 1.10.3.
applicableAreas: Building locations 1-8 relative to OHE line at southern boundary

findings.comment: Surveyed elevations of existing overhead conductors and building elevation drawings showing clearance dimensions are required to verify 7'6" sky-to-ground clearance is maintained from conductors to building faces and projections.
applicableAreas: All proposed buildings (Buildings 1-8) on site

findings.comment: Building elevation sheets with surveyed overhead conductor elevations and clearance dimensions must be provided to verify 7.5-foot horizontal sky-to-ground clearance is maintained from all buildings to existing overhead electric conductors.
applicableAreas: Buildings 1-8 on site plan

findings.comment: Clearance dimension lines showing 15-foot radial clearance from outside conductor of overhead distribution primary and neutral conductors to all customer facilities must be provided on site plan and section views.
applicableAreas: Building locations 1-8 relative to existing overhead distribution lines

findings.comment: Plans must specify whether existing overhead lines are distribution primary/neutral conductors, and provide 15-foot radial clearance dimensions from outside conductor to all customer facilities in plan and section views.
applicableAreas: All customer facilities (buildings 1-8, parking, infrastructure) relative to OHE line on southern boundary

findings.comment: Plans must show radial clearance dimensions from the outside conductor of overhead distribution primary and neutral conductors to all proposed buildings, parking areas, and site facilities, demonstrating minimum 15-foot radial clearance is maintained.
applicableAreas: All proposed buildings and site facilities

findings.comment: Building elevation sheets showing all building projections (overhangs, awnings, balconies, decks, roofs, patios) with dimensions and clearance verification from overhead electric conductors are required.
applicableAreas: Building projections on all 8 proposed buildings relative to OHE line

findings.comment: Building elevation sheets with surveyed overhead conductor elevations and dimension annotations showing clearances from conductors to all building projections (roofs, parapets, overhangs, decks, patios) must be provided.
applicableAreas: Building roofs, parapets, overhangs, and projections on Buildings 1-8

findings.comment: Building elevation drawings must show all building projections (overhangs, awnings, balconies, decks, patios) with clearance dimensions to overhead electric conductors demonstrating both 7.5-foot sky-to-ground and 15-foot radial clearances are maintained.
applicableAreas: All proposed buildings

findings.comment: Building elevations with labeled clearance dimensions from overhead electric facilities in adjacent ROW must be provided, demonstrating both 7.5-foot sky-to-ground and 15-foot radial clearances.
applicableAreas: Buildings adjacent to Valley View Road ROW

findings.comment: Austin Energy utility plan showing exact location of overhead facilities in adjacent ROW with clearance dimensions from buildings must be provided.
applicableAreas: Buildings 1, 2, and other structures near Valley View Road ROW

findings.comment: Building elevation sheets must show surveyed overhead conductor elevations with clearance dimensions demonstrating buildings maintain minimum 7.5-foot horizontal sky-to-ground and 15-foot radial clearances from electric facilities in adjacent right-of-way.
applicableAreas: Buildings 1, 2, and other structures near Valley View Road right-of-way

findings.comment: Building elevation sheets must be submitted, including registered surveyor data showing surveyed conductor elevation and clearance dimension annotations for all buildings within potential clearance distance of overhead electric facilities.
applicableAreas: All proposed buildings 1-8 relative to overhead electric facilities

findings.comment: Building elevation sheets prepared by registered surveyor must include surveyed elevations and locations of existing overhead conductors with dimension annotations showing clearances to building components.
applicableAreas: All proposed buildings (Buildings 1-8)

findings.comment: Building elevation sheets showing surveyed elevations and locations of overhead conductors with clearance dimension annotations must be provided to demonstrate required clearances are met. These sheets must be sealed by a registered surveyor and engineer.
applicableAreas: All proposed buildings

findings.comment: Section and plan view exhibits must be added showing dimensions from the outer electric conductor to the outermost edge of each building and building projection for clearance verification per UCM § 1.10.3. Dimension lines must originate at the outside conductor location, not pole center.
applicableAreas: All proposed buildings 1-8 and any building projections

findings.comment: Provide enlarged plan details and section views with dimension lines extending from outside conductor to outermost edges of all buildings and building projections, demonstrating required clearance envelopes are maintained.
applicableAreas: All buildings and projections relative to OHE line on southern boundary

findings.comment: Section and plan view exhibits with dimension lines from the outer conductor to the outermost edge of buildings and building projections must be provided for all proposed structures within potential clearance distance of overhead electric facilities.
applicableAreas: All buildings and projections

findings.comment: Dimension annotations must be provided showing fence post locations maintain minimum 10-foot horizontal clearance from existing electric poles.
applicableAreas: Proposed fence locations relative to existing electric poles

findings.comment: Site plan must clearly identify existing utility pole locations and provide dimension annotations showing minimum 10-foot clearance from fence posts to pole centerlines.
applicableAreas: Fence posts relative to utility poles at property corners

findings.comment: Plan view dimensions must demonstrate fence post locations maintain minimum 10-foot horizontal clearance from existing electric utility pole centers.
applicableAreas: Fencing locations relative to existing utility poles

findings.comment: Section views showing retaining wall elevations with dimensions from outer electric conductor to outermost edge of wall must be provided to demonstrate compliance with 7.5-foot sky-to-ground clearance requirement.
applicableAreas: Retaining walls in relation to overhead electric facilities

findings.comment: If retaining walls are located near overhead electric lines, provide section views with dimension annotations showing 7.5-foot horizontal sky-to-ground clearance from outside conductor to wall face.
applicableAreas: Retaining walls around biofiltration pond if located near overhead lines

findings.comment: Plan and section views must show dimensions from the outermost electric line to retaining wall faces, demonstrating minimum 7.5-foot horizontal sky-to-ground clearance is maintained.
applicableAreas: Retaining walls around site perimeter

findings.comment: Section views for retaining walls must be provided showing dimensions from outer electric conductor to wall face for clearance verification per UCM § 1.10.3.
applicableAreas: Retaining walls near overhead electric facilities

findings.comment: Section views for retaining walls near any overhead electric lines must include dimension annotations showing clearance from outside conductor to wall face.
applicableAreas: Retaining walls around biofiltration detention pond

findings.comment: Section exhibits must show dimensions from the outer conductor to the outermost edge of each retaining wall for clearance verification.
applicableAreas: Retaining walls

findings.comment: Vertical clearance dimensions must be provided for the driveway where the OHE line crosses, showing minimum 16-foot or 18-foot clearance from the lowest point of the overhead electric line (including any attachments) to the finished driveway grade. Registered surveyor data for mid-span clearance verification is required.
applicableAreas: Main driveway entrance at southwest portion of site where OHE line crosses

findings.comment: Registered surveyor mid-span clearance data must be provided showing vertical clearance from lowest point of overhead facilities (including all conductors and attachments) to finished driveway grades. Section views must show 16-foot clearance for parking without truck traffic or 18-foot for areas with truck traffic.
applicableAreas: Driveways and parking areas if located beneath or adjacent to OHE line

findings.comment: Grading plan and section views must show vertical clearance dimensions from the lowest point of overhead electric facilities (including telecommunications attachments) to finished driveway grade, demonstrating 16-foot minimum (18-foot if truck traffic).
applicableAreas: All driveways on site

findings.comment: All clearance dimension lines must originate at the outside conductor (the actual electric wire), not from pole center or centerline of multi-conductor installations. On three-phase installations, the conductor may be several feet offset from pole center. Dimension line endpoints must clearly show measurement origin at the conductor location.
applicableAreas: All clearance dimensions on site plan where overhead electric facilities exist

findings.comment: All clearance dimension annotations must explicitly originate at the outside conductor location, not at the utility pole centerline or pole face. Dimension lines and callouts must clearly show measurement origin point (e.g., '15'-0" from outside conductor').
applicableAreas: All clearance dimensions relative to overhead electric infrastructure

findings.comment: Any clearance dimension annotations must explicitly show that dimensions are measured from the outside conductor (the actual electric wire), not from utility pole centerline. Dimension lines must originate at the outer conductor location.
applicableAreas: All clearance dimensions shown on plans

findings.comment: If sidewalks are positioned at or near existing power pole locations at the property boundary along ROW, clearance dimensions must be provided showing sidewalk alignment and pole location.
applicableAreas: Sidewalk alignment along Valley View Road ROW frontage near existing power poles

findings.comment: Enlarged plan details must show existing power pole locations at property ends and document that proposed sidewalk alignments maintain adequate clearance from pole structures, or note if poles are to be relocated.
applicableAreas: Sidewalks along Valley View Road frontage at property ends

findings.comment: Plan view must clarify that new or modified sidewalks at each end of the property along right-of-way frontage are cleared of existing power poles, or if poles must be relocated to accommodate sidewalk.
applicableAreas: Sidewalk alignments at property boundaries along Valley View Road

findings.comment: Clearance dimensions must be provided showing water line routing maintains adequate separation from overhead distribution poles and conductors.
applicableAreas: Water line routing relative to overhead distribution poles and conductors

findings.comment: Utility plan must include dimension annotations showing clearance distances from water line routing to all overhead electric poles and conductors.
applicableAreas: Water line routing relative to overhead distribution infrastructure

findings.comment: Utility plan must show clearance dimensions between proposed water line routing and existing overhead distribution poles and conductors.
applicableAreas: Water line routing on utility plans

findings.comment: Registered surveyor data must be provided showing pole locations, overhead conductor elevations, and mid-span clearance measurements for the driveway crossing. This data is essential to verify the minimum 16-foot or 18-foot vertical clearance requirement per UCM § 1.10.6.2.
applicableAreas: Driveway where OHE line crosses

findings.comment: Registered surveyor must provide documented mid-span clearance measurements for existing overhead facilities showing vertical distance from lowest point of conductors and attachments to highest proposed site features (building roofs, HVAC equipment, etc.) to demonstrate code-required clearances are maintained.
applicableAreas: All site features with vertical extent (buildings, parking structures, etc.)

findings.comment: Registered surveyor clearance survey showing pole locations and mid-span clearances from overhead facilities to driveways, parking areas, and buildings must be provided to verify all vertical clearance requirements (7.5-foot, 16-foot, 18-foot) are satisfied.
applicableAreas: All areas where overhead facilities may affect site features

findings.comment: If decorative lighting fixtures are positioned beneath overhead electric lines, clearance dimensions must be provided showing 7.5-foot sky-to-ground and 15-foot radial clearances from the outside conductor, or alternative relocation notes.
applicableAreas: Decorative lighting fixture locations near OHE line

findings.comment: Photometric plan or enlarged lighting detail must show locations of all decorative light fixtures near overhead electric lines with dimension annotations verifying clearance requirements are met (7.5-foot sky-to-ground, 15-foot radial), or notes indicating fixtures are relocated away from lines.
applicableAreas: Decorative lighting fixtures if located near overhead electric line

findings.comment: Photometric plan or site plan must show decorative lighting fixture locations with clearance verification demonstrating 7.5-foot sky-to-ground and 15-foot radial clearances from overhead lines, or relocation notes if conflicts exist.
applicableAreas: Proposed decorative lighting locations

findings.comment: All trees proposed within 10 lateral feet of overhead distribution conductors must be from the Utility Compatible Shade Trees list (ECM Appendix F, marked 'UC'). The currently proposed species (Live Oak, Cedar Elm, Texas Mountain Laurel, Mexican Redbud) are not utility-compatible. Trees must either be relocated to positions more than 10 feet from conductors, or replaced with utility-compatible species verified in ECM Appendix F 'UC' column.
applicableAreas: Trees planted at southern property boundary near OHE line (Landscape Plan Sheet 31)

findings.comment: Plant schedule must specify which tree species are utility-compatible per ECM Appendix F for planting within 10 lateral feet of overhead distribution conductors. Tree species must be marked or noted as 'UC' (Utility Compatible, generally ≤20' mature height). Plan must include dimension annotations showing lateral distance (horizontal) from each tree location to the overhead conductor and note species compliance with utility compatibility requirement.
applicableAreas: Trees within 10 lateral feet of OHE line on southern boundary

findings.comment: Landscape plan must verify that all trees proposed within 10 lateral feet of overhead distribution conductors or 50 lateral feet of transmission conductors (per more restrictive UCM 50-foot standard) are species marked 'UC' (Utility Compatible) in ECM Appendix F, generally mature height ≤20 feet. Annotate lateral distances.
applicableAreas: Proposed tree plantings on landscape plan

findings.comment: Enlarged detail drawings of proposed meter locations must be provided showing no obstructions to meter access and working clearances: minimum 30 inches wide, 36 inches deep front access space, and 6.5 feet headroom per UCM § 1.10.9.
applicableAreas: Electrical meter locations shown on Sheet 21

findings.comment: Enlarged meter detail views must show 30-inch front width, 36-inch front depth, and 6.5-foot headroom clearances around each meter location, confirming no site features, fences, walls, vegetation, or building projections obstruct access.
applicableAreas: Electrical meter locations throughout site

findings.comment: Electrical plan details must verify that meter access areas maintain required working clearances: 30-inch-wide clear space, 36-inch front depth, 6.5-foot headroom, with no obstructions from fences, walls, equipment, vegetation, or building projections.
applicableAreas: Proposed electric meter locations

findings.comment: Down guy wire locations and anchors must be clearly identified on the site plan relative to all proposed accessible paths and driveways. Any conflicts must be resolved through pole relocation or conversion to self-supporting steel poles, with details and relocation notes provided.
applicableAreas: Down guy wire locations relative to proposed driveways and accessible paths

findings.comment: Site plan must clearly identify existing down guy wire anchor locations and document resolution of any conflicts with proposed accessible routes and driveways through pole relocation or conversion to self-supporting poles, or provide plan notes confirming no conflicts exist.
applicableAreas: Down guy anchor locations relative to proposed accessible routes and driveways

findings.comment: Site plan must show down guy wire anchor locations from existing poles and verify they do not conflict with proposed accessible paths or driveways. If conflicts exist, plans must show pole relocation or conversion to self-supporting steel poles.
applicableAreas: Accessible paths and driveway alignments

findings.comment: Dedicated easements for down guy anchors must be clearly shown on the easement exhibit, displaying 10-foot width and minimum 5-foot extension past where the guy wire enters the ground, per Austin Energy Transmission Engineering Standards.
applicableAreas: Down guy anchor locations identified on existing survey

findings.comment: Easement exhibit and plat must identify and show 10-foot-wide down guy anchor easements extending minimum 5 feet past ground entry point for each down guy support cable on property.
applicableAreas: Down guy anchor points at property corners

findings.comment: Easement exhibit must show dedicated easements for any down guy anchors from existing distribution poles, 10 feet wide extending minimum 5 feet past where anchor enters ground.
applicableAreas: Down guy anchor locations

findings.comment: A site logistics plan or construction phasing plan must be submitted showing staging areas, equipment laydown zones, crane swing radius, material storage, and scaffold locations, with explicit notation that all construction activities maintain minimum 10-foot radial clearance from energized overhead electric lines per OSHA 1910.333 and UCM § 1.10.2.
applicableAreas: Construction staging and equipment operation zones relative to OHE line

findings.comment: Construction logistics plan or site phasing plan must document staging area boundaries, crane swing radius zones, equipment laydown areas, and work platforms with dimension annotations verifying 10-foot radial clearance from all overhead electric lines. Construction management notes must address overhead line safety during all phases.
applicableAreas: Construction staging areas, equipment operation zones, work platforms

findings.comment: Site logistics or construction phasing plan must show construction staging areas, equipment operation zones, and work platform locations with verified 10-foot radial clearance from overhead electric lines per OSHA and Texas law requirements.
applicableAreas: Construction staging areas

findings.comment: A plan note must be added to the cover sheet or general notes stating: 'The owner/contractor must notify Austin Energy at least 48 hours before work begins near high-voltage overhead lines' per Texas Health & Safety Code Chapter 752, Section 752.003.
applicableAreas: Cover sheet or general notes

findings.comment: Add note to cover sheet or general notes: 'Owner/contractor shall notify Austin Energy at least 48 hours before beginning any construction activities or operations near overhead electric lines. Contact Austin Energy at [number] per Texas Health & Safety Code Chapter 752, Section 752.003.'
applicableAreas: Cover sheet or general notes

findings.comment: Plans must include a note stating: 'Owner/contractor must notify Austin Energy at least 48 hours before work begins near high-voltage overhead lines' per Texas Health & Safety Code Chapter 752, Section 752.003.
applicableAreas: Cover sheet or general notes

findings.comment: Six mitigation trees shown directly on overhead electric line on landscape plan, with no clearance maintained from distribution conductor and no UC status documented for proposed species in plant schedule.
applicableAreas: southern property boundary along Valley View Road where OHE runs

findings.comment: Non-utility-compatible trees (Cedar Elm, Live Oak) are being planted within the 15-foot restricted zone adjacent to overhead electric distribution lines. No Austin Energy approval is documented.
applicableAreas: Southern property boundary near overhead electric line

findings.comment: Non-utility-compatible trees (Cedar Elm, Live Oak) are positioned along the overhead electric distribution line boundary on the landscape plan without documented clearance verification or Austin Energy written approval. Provide documented Austin Energy approval authorizing these species within the restricted zone, or relocate trees to beyond 15 lateral feet from the outside conductor.
applicableAreas: Southern property boundary where OHE distribution line runs

findings.comment: Large trees (Live Oak and Cedar Elm with mature heights 40+ feet per ECM Appendix F) shown directly on distribution OHE line on landscape plan, violating 25-foot minimum clearance from distribution conductors.
applicableAreas: southern property boundary OHE line where large tree mitigation trees are planted

findings.comment: Large trees (Cedar Elm and Live Oak, both 40+ feet mature height per ECM Appendix F) are proposed within 25 feet of overhead electric distribution lines without documented clearance verification or Austin Energy approval.
applicableAreas: Southern property boundary near overhead electric line

findings.comment: Large trees (Cedar Elm at 40-50 feet, Live Oak at 50-80 feet, Hackberry at 40-60 feet mature height) are positioned along the overhead electric distribution line without documented clearance verification or Austin Energy approval. Provide clearance calculations or documented Austin Energy approval for trees within 25 feet of the distribution conductor, or relocate large trees to beyond 25 lateral feet from the outside conductor.
applicableAreas: Southern property boundary where OHE distribution line runs

findings.comment: Utility poles exist on site but clearance distances from proposed trees to poles are not dimensioned or documented on landscape plan.
applicableAreas: western boundary where utility poles are located; all property perimeters where trees are shown

findings.comment: Utility pole locations are not clearly dimensioned on the landscape plan relative to proposed tree locations. Clearance verification cannot be completed from available documentation.
applicableAreas: Area near overhead electric lines

findings.comment: Trees are positioned along the OHE line boundary where utility poles are located. Provide clearance documentation demonstrating all trees are at least 10 lateral feet from each pole, or relocate trees to meet this clearance requirement.
applicableAreas: Southern property boundary where utility poles are located

findings.comment: Distances between proposed trees and underground electrical equipment not documented on plans.
applicableAreas: throughout site where underground electrical infrastructure and planted trees intersect

findings.comment: Specific locations of underground electrical equipment are not dimensioned relative to tree placements. Clearance verification cannot be determined from available documentation.
applicableAreas: Areas with underground electrical equipment

findings.comment: Underground electric equipment locations from electrical plan (Sheet 21) are not shown on landscape plan (Sheet 31). Provide landscape plan with underground equipment (pull boxes, vaults) overlaid and labeled, with clearance dimensions from proposed and retained trees to all underground equipment, or add dimension callouts demonstrating trees are at least 5 lateral feet from all underground equipment.
applicableAreas: Locations of underground electric pull boxes and vaults

findings.comment: Root barrier specifications, depths, and positions not documented for trees within 20 feet of underground electrical equipment.
applicableAreas: areas within 20 feet of underground electrical equipment

findings.comment: Trees within 20 feet of underground electrical equipment are not identified on the landscape plan, and root barrier specifications for such locations are not shown on landscape details.
applicableAreas: Areas where trees are within 20 feet of underground equipment

findings.comment: For any trees proposed within 20 lateral feet of underground electric equipment, provide root barrier details on a landscape detail sheet specifying minimum 4-foot depth and 5-foot offset from equipment. Alternatively, provide landsca plan documentation showing all trees are beyond 20 feet from underground equipment.
applicableAreas: Trees within 20 feet of underground electric equipment

findings.comment: Live Oak and Cedar Elm are large trees (40+ feet mature height per ECM Appendix F) but plant schedule does not differentiate or identify them as large trees; only planting size (16' minimum) is documented.
applicableAreas: landscape plan and plant schedule for Live Oak and Cedar Elm

findings.comment: Large trees (mature height 40+ feet per ECM Appendix F) are not visually differentiated on the landscape plan. Plant schedule lists installation heights (16'), not mature heights, making it difficult to identify trees subject to large-tree clearance restrictions.
applicableAreas: Cedar Elm and Live Oak tree locations on landscape plan

findings.comment: Large trees (mature height ≥40 feet) are not differentiated on the landscape plan. Add a note to the plant schedule specifying mature height for each proposed tree species, and use a distinct symbol or notation on the landscape plan to identify large trees (Cedar Elm ~40-50 ft, Live Oak ~50-80 ft, Hackberry ~40-60 ft) to allow verification of electrical clearance compliance.
applicableAreas: Landscape plan where trees are proposed near overhead electric facilities

findings.comment: Six trees positioned directly on overhead electric line without documented written approval from Austin Energy authorizing the clearance variance.
applicableAreas: southern property boundary where mitigation trees are positioned on OHE line

findings.comment: Trees are proposed within prohibited clearance zones (non-UC Cedar Elm and Live Oak within 15 feet of overhead distribution line). No documented Austin Energy written approval is provided. Applicant must obtain explicit written approval from Austin Energy or modify tree species/locations to comply with clearance requirements.
applicableAreas: Trees proposed within 15 feet of overhead distribution conductors

findings.comment: Trees are positioned within prohibited electrical clearance zones without documented written approval from Austin Energy. Obtain and submit explicit written approval from Austin Energy authorizing the proposed tree placement (species, locations, and sizes) within restricted zones, or relocate all trees to comply with minimum clearance distances (15 feet from distribution conductors for non-utility-compatible trees, 25 feet for large trees, 10 feet from utility poles).
applicableAreas: Southern property boundary where trees are positioned near OHE line and poles

findings.comment: Transformer pad locations are shown but clearance dimensions to buildings are not documented. Submit detailed plan sheets showing measured clearances from each transformer pad to all adjacent buildings and structures.
applicableAreas: All transformer pad locations - Sheet 21 (four pads) and Sheet 9 (one pad labeled)

findings.comment: Transformer pad locations shown but pad dimensions and horizontal clearances to buildings not dimensioned on plans. Cannot verify minimum 5-foot clearance requirement.
applicableAreas: All 5 transformer pad locations on site

findings.comment: Transformer pads shown on electrical plan but without any documented clearance measurements or dimension callouts to verify 5-foot minimum horizontal clearance from buildings, structures, and foundations. Applicant must provide dimensioned site plan or construction details showing clearances from each pad to adjacent structures.
applicableAreas: Transformer Pads 1, 2, 3, 4 on electrical design plan (Sheet 21)

findings.comment: Fences are shown on site. Submit clearance dimensions from transformer pads to fences, and identify transformer access door orientation to verify compliance with differential clearance requirements (5 feet vs. 3 feet per UCM § 1.10.4).
applicableAreas: Transformer pads relative to fences on property boundaries, especially western and southern perimeter

findings.comment: Clearances from transformer pads to any adjacent fences not dimensioned; transformer operator/control designations not identified.
applicableAreas: All transformer pad locations if fences are adjacent

findings.comment: Transformer Pad 4 is positioned very close to the southern property line wood fence with no documented clearance measurements. Applicant must provide dimensioned clearances from the pad to the adjacent fence, and clarify the access door orientation to determine whether 5-foot clearance (if operators/controls side) or 3-foot clearance (if non-access side) applies. If clearance is less than required, additional setback or fence modification must be documented.
applicableAreas: Transformer Pad 4 (southern property line, adjacent to wood fence)

findings.comment: No reduced clearances (less than 5 feet) are documented on the submitted plans. If the applicant intends to use reduced 3-foot clearances to brick/masonry buildings, submit Austin Energy Design written approval and architectural specifications documenting 3-hour fire rating in the clearance area.
applicableAreas: Only applicable if clearances less than 5 feet to buildings are proposed (not shown on submitted plans)

findings.comment: No reduced clearances shown; documentation of AE Design approval and required conditions not provided.

If any transformer pads are proposed with clearances less than 5 feet to brick or masonry buildings, the plans must include documentation of: (1) written Austin Energy Design approval, (2) verification of minimum 3-hour fire rating in the clearance area (from architectural specifications), (3) confirmation that the location is not in a confined space, (4) verification of minimum 10 feet clearance to windows/doors/ducts, and (5) verification of minimum 15 feet vertical clearance to windows/doors/ducts. No such documentation is currently provided.
applicableAreas: All transformer pads shown on Sheet 21

findings.comment: No balcony or overhang clearance documentation is provided. If balconies or overhangs exist above or adjacent to transformer pads, submit building elevations or cross-sections demonstrating minimum 5-foot lateral clearance and confirming no structures directly above pads.
applicableAreas: Transformer pad locations relative to building balconies and overhangs (if present)

findings.comment: Building elevations and sections not provided; no clearances shown from balconies or overhangs to transformer pads.
applicableAreas: All transformer pad locations relative to building features

findings.comment: If balconies or overhangs exist on adjacent buildings within 5 feet of any transformer pads, provide building elevation views confirming minimum 5-foot lateral clearance and verification that no coverings or structures exist directly above pad or minimum equipment area.
applicableAreas: All transformer pads (Sheet 21)

findings.comment: No building elevations or transformer type specifications are provided. Submit building elevation sheets showing window, door, and ventilation locations, transformer equipment specifications identifying whether oil-filled, and measured clearance distances demonstrating compliance with UCM § 1.10.4 Table 1.10.4 (12 feet minimum for oil-filled equipment when clearance conditions are met).
applicableAreas: Transformer pads relative to adjacent buildings' windows, doors, and ventilation (if present)

findings.comment: Building elevations not provided; window/door locations unknown; transformer equipment type (oil-filled vs dry-type) not specified.
applicableAreas: All transformer pad locations relative to building apertures

findings.comment: Applicant must provide building elevations and electrical equipment specifications (oil-filled vs. dry-type) for each transformer. If windows, doors, or ventilating ducts exist on adjacent buildings, provide dimensioned clearances showing minimum 12-foot horizontal clearance from edge of oil-filled equipment pad when window/door/duct is less than 12 feet from grade or has less than 5 feet lateral separation.
applicableAreas: All transformer pads (if windows/doors/ducts are adjacent)

findings.comment: Sidewalks are shown on site plan. Submit clearance dimensions demonstrating minimum 2-foot separation from transformer pad edges to back of sidewalk per UCM § 1.10.4 Table 1.10.4.
applicableAreas: Transformer pad locations adjacent to proposed sidewalks, particularly the western pad near Bldg 2

findings.comment: Sidewalk locations noted but clearances from transformer pads to back-of-sidewalk not dimensioned.
applicableAreas: Transformer pads adjacent to sidewalks (western perimeter and internal paths)

findings.comment: Sidewalk is shown adjacent to Transformer Pad 1 on Site Plan (Sheet 9) without documented clearance dimension. Applicant must provide measured distance from transformer pad edge to back of sidewalk, confirming minimum 2-foot clearance.
applicableAreas: Transformer Pad 1 (western entrance area, adjacent to sidewalk)

findings.comment: No fire escape locations are shown on site plan sheets. If fire escapes or stairs serving as fire escapes are present on the buildings, submit building elevations showing their locations and clearance dimensions from transformer pads (minimum 20 feet for oil-filled equipment per UCM § 1.10.4 Table 1.10.4).
applicableAreas: Transformer pads relative to fire escapes or stairs serving as fire escapes (if present on buildings)

findings.comment: Fire escape locations not shown; transformer type (oil-filled vs dry-type) not specified; clearances not dimensioned.
applicableAreas: All transformer pad locations relative to fire escapes (if present)

findings.comment: If fire escapes or stairs serving as fire exits exist on adjacent buildings, provide site plan with dimensioned locations showing minimum 20-foot horizontal/radial clearance from edge of oil-filled transformer pad. Provide electrical specifications identifying equipment as oil-filled.

Transformer pad locations are shown but access door orientation is not identified. Submit detailed site plan sheets showing transformer access door orientation and dimensions demonstrating minimum 10-foot clearance from hot-stick use area (access door side) to open area or adjacent building per UCM § 1.10.4 Table 1.10.4.
applicableAreas: All four transformer pad locations on Sheet 21

findings.comment: Access door orientations not identified; hot-stick clearance dimensions not shown.
applicableAreas: All 5 transformer pad locations

findings.comment: Applicant must clearly identify the access door orientation (with directional arrow or note) for each transformer pad on the electrical plan, and provide dimensioned measurements from the access door side of each pad to the nearest open area or adjacent building/structure, confirming minimum 10-foot clearance in the hot-stick use area.
applicableAreas: All transformer pads (Pads 1, 2, 3, 4 on Sheet 21)

findings.comment: No niche or enclosed area transformer configurations are indicated on submitted plans. If any transformer is located in a confined space (enclosed on 3+ sides), submit cross-section drawings demonstrating 15-foot vertical clearance per UCM § 1.10.4 Table 1.10.4.
applicableAreas: Only applicable if transformer faces confined space such as niche or enclosed area (not shown as proposed)

findings.comment: Niche/enclosed area configuration not documented; building cross-sections not provided.
applicableAreas: Transformer pads if located in confined spaces (not identified)

findings.comment: If any transformer locations involve niches (equipment accessible from outside but within building footprint) or enclosed/notched-out building configurations, provide cross-section drawings demonstrating minimum 35-foot vertical clearance from grade through entire access path, and provide documentation of 3-hour fire wall rating and ventilation specifications.
Fire hydrant is shown on site. Submit clearance dimension from nearest transformer pad to fire hydrant, demonstrating minimum 5-foot separation per Reviewer Convention.
applicableAreas: Transformer pad locations relative to the private fire hydrant location shown on Sheet 10

findings.comment: Fire hydrant locations shown but clearances from transformer pads not dimensioned.
applicableAreas: Transformer pad locations relative to fire hydrants

findings.comment: Provide dimensioned measurements on electrical plan showing minimum 5-foot clearance from each transformer pad to fire hydrant locations identified on the fire protection plan (Sheet 10).
applicableAreas: All transformer pads relative to fire hydrant locations (Sheet 21 vs. Sheet 10)

findings.comment: Tree locations are shown on landscape plan but species are not identified with ECM Appendix F utility compatibility ratings. Submit tree species list with ECM Appendix F 'UC' (Utility Compatible) designations for all trees within 10 lateral feet of transformer pads or 15 lateral feet of overhead electric conductors per UCM § 1.10.10.4.
applicableAreas: Trees within 10 lateral feet of pad-mounted equipment or 15 lateral feet of overhead distribution conductors (tree locations shown on Sheets 31, 33, 34)

findings.comment: Tree species and utility-compatibility status documented but spatial proximity of specific trees to transformer pads not correlated.
applicableAreas: All proposed tree planting locations relative to transformer pads

findings.comment: Applicant must provide a utility compatibility analysis documenting: (1) which trees are located within 10 lateral feet of each transformer pad or 15 lateral feet of overhead distribution, (2) confirmation that all such trees are identified as utility-compatible species per ECM Appendix F 'UC' column, with species names and caliper information. If non-compatible species are within these proximity ranges, relocation or removal must be shown.
applicableAreas: Landscape plan (Sheet 31) relative to transformer locations (Sheet 21)

findings.comment: Landscaping is shown on site but clearance dimensions from plantings to transformer pads are not provided. Submit detailed planting plan with dimensions showing: (1) minimum 10 lateral feet clearance from shrubs/vegetation to transformer access door side, and (2) minimum 5 lateral feet clearance from other sides, per UCM § 1.10.10.4.
applicableAreas: Landscaping locations relative to all four transformer pads shown on Sheet 21

findings.comment: Shrub/vegetation planting locations not correlated to transformer pad locations or access door orientations.
applicableAreas: All transformer pad locations relative to proposed shrub planting

findings.comment: Applicant must: (1) clearly identify access door orientation on each transformer pad on the electrical plan, (2) provide detailed landscape plan analysis showing minimum 10-foot clearance from transformer access door sides and minimum 5-foot clearance from non-access sides for all shrubs, groundcovers, and low-lying vegetation, with specific plant types and locations dimensioned.
